comments.author: @40below1000
comments.text:
Port Alberni on Vancouver Island checking in. 

Wall of text coming: There are areas of every major city in North America that are as bad, or worse than any of the slums shown here. My job took me to a couple of the ones here and a lot of others I'd consider worse, but I never worried about my personal safety or being robbed there. I recall leaning, peeling tar paper shacks with brigh curtains that the woman of the house put up because even if you're living in a ditch you have to have standards. I saw something like that everywhere I went and if you look closely enough at the drone feed,  you will see a lot of effort expended in making these huts look like homes rather than replaceable trash. I've been to a few American examples, people don't give a damn about their areas (counterpoint: most "urban" populations don't own houses and businesses so they have little interest in keeping things up that they do not own) but  I certainly never once felt safe.
